PPI network analysis of TWP targets

PPI network analysis of TWP targets. (A) Global PPI network with MCODE-identified subnetworks: Subnetwork 1: Signaling pathways (score = 10.364). Subnetwork 2: Steroid hormone biosynthesis (score = 9.000). Subnetwork 3: Inflammation/apoptosis (score = 5.500). Node size reflects connectivity; edges indicate interactions. (B) Top 10 hub genes ranked by degree centrality (interconnected subnetwork)
